## What's new

### Smoother reading
- **Scroll mode in long surahs such as Al-Baqarah is much smoother.** Pages are prepared before you reach them, the nearest first, pages off screen cost nothing to draw, and the text size of every page now ships with the app. Scrolling very fast is still not perfect.
- **No more flash of broken letters** when a page appears.

### Tips that appear when they help
- **Small tips offer a setting when you keep doing what it is for.** Turning pages suggests two pages side by side, a translation in your language, scrolling instead of pages, and zoom with Fit or Fill. Others cover keeping the player in view, staying with the recitation, and a wider page.
- At most one tip per session and one per day, never when you have already changed the setting. Switch them all off in **Settings → App & window → Show tips**.

### A clearer look
- **One button style everywhere.** Buttons have a soft fill and outline, the chosen option in a group is tinted with the accent, and the page-turn arrows, zoom buttons, pickers and tabs all match.
- **A new language step in the first-run setup:** a searchable list of languages beside the list of translations, with the translator shown for each.
- **A smoother player bar.** It floats as a rounded card, slides in and out more gently, and has a round play button, a seek knob and a styled volume slider.

### Updates and safety
- **A bottom-left notice says when a new version is ready**, with one button, Restart to update.
- **The app now has a content security policy**, limiting what the window may load.
- **Linux:** the AppImage no longer stops with "Could not load this surah".
- Release builds now use pinned versions of their build steps.
